quote: Where the signal is a green straight-through arrow alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal may proceed straight through, but must not turn right or left. Such vehicular traffic must yield the right-of-way to other vehicles and to pedestrians lawfully within the intersection or an adjacent crosswalk at the time the signal is exhibited.

activation.condition: Vehicular traffic faces a green straight-through arrow alone.

obligation.description: Straight movement is permitted; right or left turns are prohibited, and traffic must yield to lawfully present vehicles and pedestrians.

timing.description: Participant presence is evaluated at the time the signal is exhibited.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The source supplies no numeric yielding boundary.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: lawfully within the intersection or an adjacent crosswalk
judgment_calls_needed.note: Lawful presence requires independent signal and right-of-way context.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: lawfully present or clear physical region
